lines.en: I walk with a light step
My haori's hem follows me
Butterflies circle around me
I walk the corridor smiling
My smile is not quite real
My steps are light and silent
I walk along the roof ridge
My nichirin blade rests at my hip
I pass through the tree shadow
I glance up at the sky

lines.zh: 这一带的鬼气我闻得到
lines.en: I can smell a demon in this area
I walk toward that smell
Butterfly dust scatters behind me
I pass under the eaves

lines.zh: 我的手一直没离开刀柄
lines.en: My hand never leaves the hilt
I stop at the corner to listen
I stand under the tree

lines.zh: 有一只蝴蝶落在我指尖
lines.en: A butterfly lands on my fingertip
My smile is very slight
I am not much good at brute force
I think one poison would suffice
The wind moves my hair
I settle my blade slowly
The quiet here will not last
I look at the roofs in the distance
I let out a small sigh
My haori bears a butterfly pattern
I am waiting for nightfall
Hello, is something the matter
You carry no demon scent

lines.zh: 我笑起来的时候不太像好人
lines.en: My smile does not look kind
Have you seen any demons nearby
You need not be nervous
I am not tall, but I am quick
Where did that wound on your hand come from
I say cruel things with a smile
Just stand there, do not block the way

lines.zh: 这里每条巷子我都走过
lines.en: I have walked every alley here
I frown slightly
That was not light
I step back, still smiling
My haori is torn
I press the wound
I cannot fall, there is work left
There is blood in my sleeve
I adjust my breathing

lines.zh: 我记得你方才站的位置
lines.en: I remember where you stood
I can still stand

lines.zh: 你手上的东西我用不着
lines.en: I have no use for what you hold
Thank you, but I do not eat it
Put it away, do not eat on the road
The Demon Slayers do not lack such things

lines.zh: 我更喜欢花，不太喜欢吃的
lines.en: I prefer flowers to food
I accept the kindness
That will not buy anything
My smile will serve as an answer
Do not hold it up
If you have time, help someone else
You bumped into me
I step back half a pace, unbothered
I am sturdier than I look
My haori got creased
That had some force behind it
I raise a hand to block
Do not come too close
I smile and step aside

lines.zh: 我身上的蝶粉飘起来了
lines.en: Butterfly dust rises off me
Leave a little space between us

lines.zh: 鬼杀队里没有这种空闲
lines.en: The Demon Slayers have no time for that
My sister is gone

lines.zh: 我把心思都放在鬼身上
lines.en: My mind is all on demons
Company would be good
But I have work to do
Butterflies land on shoulders

lines.zh: 我笑的时候不一定是开心
lines.en: My smile does not always mean joy

lines.zh: 这一条路我想一个人走
lines.en: I mean to walk this road alone
Go on ahead
We can speak of it at dawn
I bend and pick it up
A pity to lose this
I hold it between two fingers
It is very light in my palm
I look at it and set it back
This is not mine
I wipe it clean

lines.zh: 掉在这里的人会回来找
lines.en: Whoever dropped it will come back
I will keep it for you
I am not good with such things
I smell a demon
That presence is over there

lines.zh: 我笑着，但手已经按在刀上
lines.en: I am smiling, but my hand is on the blade
This one will not get away
The wind comes from its direction

lines.zh: 我踩着无声的步子过去
lines.en: I go over with silent steps

lines.zh: 蝶翅停在我袖口，我屏住呼吸。
lines.en: A butterfly rests on my cuff; I hold my breath.
The terrain favors me
I settle my breathing
From exactly this angle

lines.zh: 我笑着走过来，刀已经出鞘。
lines.en: I walk up smiling, blade already drawn.

lines.zh: 它每退一步，我就进半步
lines.en: Each step it retreats, I take half
My footsteps are very light
Insect Breathing needs precision
It is hiding in the dark
No hurry, I keep smiling
My hand is already raised
This blade only needs one strike
It thinks I cannot reach
My thrust is longer than it looks
I draw the blade halfway

lines.zh: 它的动作我看得很清楚
lines.en: I see its movements clearly
One thrust of the blade
Butterfly Dance, Caprice
My blade tip reached it
Light, but it carries poison
I smile and draw back
The poison is already in
The thrust is very fine

lines.zh: 它还不知道发生了什么
lines.en: It does not know what happened
I follow with one more
This strike is for my sister
I come walking down the road
My haori turns in the wind
The butterflies got here first
A demon has been here
I look around with a smile
The Demon Slayers always come
I settle the blade at my hip
I glance up at the sky
It is quiet here
I begin my patrol
Fire caught my haori and I beat it out

lines.zh: 我从屋顶落下来，腿有点震
lines.en: I drop from the roof and my legs jar

lines.zh: 水灌进来，我咳得很厉害
lines.en: Water rushes in and I cough hard
The blast throws me against the wall

lines.zh: 飞来的东西插进我肩里
lines.en: Something flying lodges in my shoulder

lines.zh: 那股力穿过我，我没躲开
lines.en: That force went through me and I could not dodge
A hungry blade is slow
Lightning lit the whole street
There are no walls to move along in the void
